players.product: OSAT (incl. JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea) - package substrate buyer from Simmtech and Daeduck Electronics

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 19,527,223,323.13, up 4.96% YoY; total profit RMB 893,758,740.43, up 56.06%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 844,644,275.04, up 79.41%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 808,334,196.16, up 84.73%; operating cash flow RMB 2,964,426,853.22, up 26.75%, with cash collected at 108.4% of revenue; R&D expense RMB 1,034,336,923.55, up 4.82%. The company attributes the growth to fast-rising demand from AI infrastructure and edge devices and a clear domestic-substitution trend: customer orders kept growing and capacity utilisation ran at a high level; a richer high-value product mix and cost cuts partly offset higher raw-material prices.

Revenue mix (half-year report): H1 2026 revenue by end application - computing electronics 30.1%, communications electronics 27.4%, consumer electronics 23.2%, automotive electronics 11.1%, industrial and medical electronics 8.2%; computing electronics revenue grew 40.4% YoY, automotive 25.0% and test business revenue 9.4%. Overseas factories had H1 revenue RMB 9,948,808,727.67 and net profit RMB 395,308,465.80; overseas assets were 34.05% of total assets.
quarterly_data.figure: computing 30.1% of revenue (+40.4% YoY); automotive 11.1% (+25.0%); test revenue +9.4%

quarterly_data.signal: Utilisation and supply (half-year report): capacity utilisation ran at a high level on growing customer orders; customer capacity deposits held in long-term payables rose to RMB 181,624,000.00 at June 30, 2026 from RMB 5,857,333.31 at the start of the year (the cash-flow note cites higher capacity deposits received from customers); inventory rose 31.08% to RMB 4,995,546,230.41, mainly stocking to fill orders. By plant: JCET Advanced Packaging (Jiangyin) orders full and utilisation kept high, net profit RMB 39,451.43 ten-thousand; JCET Microelectronics (Jiangyin) high-end advanced packaging mass-production ramp accelerated, utilisation up, revenue RMB 21,182.21 ten-thousand, net loss narrowed to RMB 8,913.19 ten-thousand; JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea revenue fell on tight upstream raw-material supply and a phased contraction in customer orders; Shengdie Semiconductor (Shanghai, flash-memory packaging) had some raw materials in tight supply and lower utilisation; Suqian and Chuzhou plants turned profitable with Chuzhou utilisation rising steadily.
quarterly_data.figure: customer capacity deposits RMB 181,624,000.00 (vs RMB 5,857,333.31 at start of 2026); inventory RMB 4,995,546,230.41 (+31.08%)

quarterly_data.signal: Automotive plant (half-year report): automotive electronics revenue RMB 21.6 hundred million in H1 2026, up 25.0%; the Lingang (Shanghai) automotive electronics plant started production in March 2026 and entered batch production in Q2, completing system build-out, customer audits and project introduction; the company says it will keep bringing production-line equipment in, raise utilisation and expand the business.
quarterly_data.figure: automotive revenue RMB 21.6 hundred million (+25.0%); production start March 2026, batch production Q2 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity investment (half-year report): cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets RMB 4,700,145,248.84 in H1 2026, up 78.18%; construction in progress RMB 5,218,684,145.17 at June 30, up 34.01%, mainly capacity expansion and R&D construction. The board approved building a high-end advanced packaging-and-test plant in Wanxiang Industrial Park, 'Oriental Chip Port', Shanghai Lingang, through a new subsidiary, total investment RMB 78 hundred million; the wholly owned subsidiary has been registered. Major projects: JCET automotive chip packaging-and-test project, budget RMB 8,000,000,000.00, 9.08% of budget invested; wafer-level microsystem integration high-end manufacturing project, budget RMB 3,800,000,000.00, 91.77% invested.
quarterly_data.figure: capex cash RMB 4,700,145,248.84 (+78.18%); CIP RMB 5,218,684,145.17; new Lingang advanced packaging plant RMB 78 hundred million

quarterly_data.signal: Technology (half-year report): the XDFOI chiplet high-density heterogeneous integration platform has reached scaled mass production (the annual report said it had entered mass production); the company is advancing hybrid bonding, panel-level advanced packaging and CPO as next-generation packaging technologies, with progress in R&D platforms and verification capability; for CPO it has built PIC-EIC heterogeneous integration capability, and its XDFOI-based silicon photonic engine remains at customer sample delivery and validation with multiple customers (not named). In memory it is extending from chip packaging and test to module and system-level products for AI servers, enterprise, automotive and industrial storage. Localisation and diversification of key equipment, core materials and substrates advanced steadily. Patent applications 444 in H1, up 30.6%.

H2 2026 outlook (half-year report, company guidance, no numeric target): the company says it will work toward its full-year operating targets, keep advanced packaging as its core strategic direction, accelerate the shift of its product mix toward AI-related applications and grow its storage and test businesses; at JCET Microelectronics it will speed mass production of key projects and capacity release.
